requirement: All named collector families and all 16 workstreams are mandatory in one R1.
Rust backend/native core, PostgreSQL and TypeScript/React UI are fixed.
No discovery probes, production replay, TLS bypass, key harvesting or business delivery changes.
Only policy-sanitized structure and approved metadata may persist or leave a collector.
Disabled-by-default capture requires enrolled identity and valid scoped signed policy.
Every parser, queue, cache and callback has tested resource limits.
Keep tenant, service, environment, deployment and source attribution distinct.
Cross-runtime canonical structure handles null, missing, exact numbers, unions and limits.
Bounded at-least-once delivery uses durable receipts and deduplication before counting.
Show visibility, partial inspection, sampling, loss, unsupported profiles and stale health.
Observed, declared and approved versions stay separate; approval is authorized and concurrent-safe.
PostgreSQL transactions, tenant isolation, retention and recovery are tested on a real server.
HTTP, JSON, XML, forms, GraphQL, gRPC and WebSocket have bounded explicit semantics.
Deployable versioned packages include all enabled-family options and offline installation.
Actual UI interactions show evidence limits and support accessible review.
Identity, isolation, imports, egress, revocation and all persistent sinks receive negative tests.
Measure defined latency, throughput, memory, overload and recovery targets.
Real platform results and exact versions are required; missing and mocked evidence cannot pass.
Health, audit, disable, upgrade, backup and recovery procedures are shipped.
Contract checks and approved exports integrate with customer workflows without blocking live capture.
